method: Manual review of Arabic-language search results for the Tunisia Arabic editorial market, competitor pages, official app listing and authoritative online-safety guidance. Search-result examples are observations only, not proof of search volume, keyword difficulty or rankings.

ar.contentGap: Search examples tend to isolate profile writing or first-message advice, or address a particular relationship/cultural niche. This guide combines an honest profile framework, examples, photo privacy, distinct relationship/friendship/professional intentions, conversation practice and the verified Célibataire feature set. It uses clear Modern Standard Arabic and does not imply one cultural or relationship model fits all.

officialAppReference.name: Célibataire: Rencontres & Chat
officialAppReference.verificationNote: Official Google Play listing opened via the DevImpact developer's More by DevImpact listing. Verified description: profiles with photos, bio, prompts and interests; age, distance and intention filters; text, photo and voice-note chat; swipe/like/SuperSwipe; women send the first message; matches expire after 24 hours and may be extended or another match sent; local storage supports exploration during unstable connection. No identity-verification, precise location-hiding or reporting feature claims were added.

sources.name: eSafety Commissioner — Online dating
sources.supports: Profile privacy, photo caution, app safety checks, boundaries and meeting guidance.

sources.name: RAINN — Tips for Safer Dating
sources.supports: Photo and link caution, financial scam awareness and reporting suspicious behavior.

editorialDecision: Create the missing Arabic version of the existing English informational guide online-dating-profile-conversation-guide. Keep the Arabic article original and localized, not a literal translation. The existing Arabic romance-scam article is a distinct topic and is linked as a complementary resource. Do not promise matches or claim unverified app safety features.
limitations: No Google Search Console query export or Google Ads Keyword Planner data was available; no search volume, ranking or difficulty claims are made.
Arabic SERP review is directional and requires future Tunisia-specific Search Console validation.
